page_note: Heavily damaged page (67.6% lacuna ratio) but the surviving content is dense cosmological substrate: the descent of the First Man, the appointed time (kairos/karos), the Panaretos, the Mother of Life summoned from the Father of Greatness, her descent from the Height of the Father to the foot of the earth through the Twelve Aeons hidden within the veil of light. Classic substrate cosmology with systematic temporal-spatial mapping. Only segment 19 introduces the apostolic teaching voice ('Hear again... I shall instruct you'). Hortatory score on seg 7 is a false positive (the 'to you' is part of cosmological reference, not exhortation).
